text:
sara: Heads-up: saw a cluster of small-tenant throttle spikes after the mapping lambda landed. Not identical to region bias incidents but looks like mapping sometimes returns 0 quota_factor.

ben: ugh. seen it on the smoke dashboards. mapping lambda returned NaN->coerced to 0 in one path when input feature 'recent_latency' was missing.

roy: is the lambda running as part of admission or on the side? we should shadow it first.

sara: it was inline due to perf concerns. proposal: move to shadow admission for 24h and add a graceful fallback (use previous mapping_version) if response invalid.

mei: also add a circuit breaker that trips if mapping errors >0.1% over 5m and fall back to legacy mapping. would prevent blast radius.

ben: agree. ops: can we flip mapping to shadow mode via feature flag quickly?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag 'mapping_inline_v2' toggled -> shadow mode enabled at 1776543220 by ben.

roy: good. two more asks: 1) emit mapping_version and mapping_status labels on token metrics so we can slice by mapping path, 2) run a replay with synthetic missing-feature cases to validate fallback.

telemetry-bot: metric-alert: mapping_error_rate = 0.04% over 1m at 1776543230. No action required yet.

mei: replay-bot can you run a 48h focused replay with injected missing-feature events (10% of calls) and output per-tenant effective_quota deltas?

replay-bot: replay-bot: queued job #9012 (48h mapping-shadow-replay). ETA ~1776546800. results -> /replays/9012/deltas.csv

ben: also: mapping should normalize detector outputs by recent quantiles, not raw scores, so retrains don't shift mapping. add to refactor list.

sara: will draft runbook steps: shadow rollout, circuit breaker thresholds, fallback mapping_version pin, and probe list (synthetic tenant IDs). will share for review.

roy: +1. after replay, if deltas <0.5% on small tenants we can flip inline with CB + linter to reject NaN/None responses.

mei: one last note: ensure billing/external metrics mark synthetic probes so they don't pollute quota usage or alerts.

ben: thanks - owners: sara (runbook + rollout), mei (circuit breaker + linter), roy (observability labels), ben (replay & fix). sync 11:30.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created canary group 'mapping-shadow-canary' at 1776543250. Monitoring hooks added (effective_quota, throttle_rate, p95).
